result: If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it impossible for anyone to go hungry — not by giving food away, but by removing scarcity itself. No child wakes up without a meal, no parent has to choose between eating and paying rent, and no one dies from a lack of calories while mountains of excess rot elsewhere. Everything else would still be hard, but at least the basic fuel for human dignity would be guaranteed.
